content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: ugh finally home, this monday felt like three days
Me: seriously, i just dropped my bag and went straight to couch
Maya: same, blanket mode activated
Me: did you ever get your soup + grilled cheese last night?
Maya: yes and it was elite, tomato from a can saves me again
Me: lol classic gourmet
Maya: how was your evening? did you do laundry or nah
Me: nah chair is still thriving, i just watched that baking show again
Maya: the mop cake one lives in my brain rent free
Me: right? who approves that
Maya: judges looked so tired lol
Me: how's your stomach today btw? any better with the oat milk?
Maya: actually yeah way less bloated today
Maya: still gonna stick with the dairy-free test for a few weeks tho
Me: makes sense, gotta be strict to actually know
Maya: exactly, thank you for being cool about doing dairy-free when we eat together
Me: of course, we'll just work around it
Maya: you're the best
Maya: oh btw are you in office hell again tomorrow?
Me: yeah, endless emails part two
Maya: ugh same, i have like two calls that could've been texts
Me: literally always
Maya: hey so i was thinking about pizza
Me: always thinking about pizza tbh
Maya: lol same, when do you wanna do Rosa's again?
Me: yes please, i need something to look forward to
Maya: this friday is kinda crazy for me, back to back stuff
Me: same, i'm slammed this week too, friday's gonna be a rush
Maya: what if we do not this friday but next friday?
Me: oh like friday next week?
Maya: yeah the one after this coming one, when things calm down
Me: that works way better for me actually
Maya: i was scrolling and saw Domino's has a deal but honestly it's too far for us
Maya: like i'm not driving across town for that when Rosa's is right here
Me: yeah no, Domino's is too out of the way
Maya: exactly, ruling that out, let's just do our usual spot
Me: Rosa's on Oak Street?
Maya: yes, Rosa's on Oak Street, garlic knots forever
Me: would 1 pm work? i can slip out for a longer lunch that day
Maya: 1 pm next friday at Rosa's? yeah that works for me
Me: perfect, i'll grab us a table like last time
Maya: patio if it's not freezing? fall is being weird
Me: yes, i'll do my official chair safety test again
Maya: lol your most important job
Me: how are we doing the dairy-free thing there? do they have vegan cheese?
Maya: i think they do? i saw marinara + veggie no-cheese option on the menu
Maya: i can do that for now while i'm testing, no milk cheese butter for me
Me: got it, fully dairy-free, i'll do the same so you don't feel weird
Maya: you don't have to! but thank you, that helps
Me: nah it's fine, we can both do veggie no-cheese and still get the vibe
Maya: and i'll just stare at your knots longingly lol
Me: i'll get half order and you can have the smell, balance
Maya: tragic but fair, stupid dairy test timing
Me: we'll be back to full knots soon
Maya: how's miracle basil doing on your end? mine is still alive on the windowsill
Me: mine are okay, i watered them yesterday so less droopy
Maya: proud plant parent redemption again
Me: are you doing pottery tomorrow? my maybe-mug gets glazed
Maya: good luck to the maybe-mug, hope it survives the kiln
Me: it's very lopsided but that's the charm right
Maya: functional art, my sister still says someday she'll join
Me: tell tuesday guy she's still thinking about it lol
Maya: i will, oh did i tell you she locked in Rosa's for her birthday thing?
Me: yeah next saturday at 4pm with her friends right?
Maya: yeah just her crew, like 6 of them, i'm not going
Me: hope they have fun, patio at 4pm should be nice
Maya: told her half order knots to start, training her well
Me: iconic order
Maya: anyway excited for our thing, 1pm next friday feels so far
Me: i know, but i need the countdown to survive this week
Maya: same, okay i'm gonna heat up leftovers, soup again probably
Me: same, might do pasta tonight, very gourmet
Maya: okay talk later? gonna go be lazy before dishes judge me
Me: yes, enjoy couch rot",
  "writer_note": "Anchored the plan as next Friday (not this Friday) at 1pm at Rosa's on Oak Street with clear proposal/acceptance, had Maya explicitly reject Domino's as too far for their own outing, and wove in dairy-free, plants, pottery and sister's separate birthday to keep it natural."
}
